title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2611.17662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents now run for hundreds of steps with little or no human supervision. In practice, practitioners use runtime monitors such as turn limits and keyword filters to decide when a run should be stopped, upgraded, or assisted. However, these heuristics may stop runs that would otherwise succeed or allow failing runs to continue. To address this limitation, we introduce LeBet (Learn then Bet), a statistical learning framework that derives its learning objective from sufficient conditions for valid and powerful intervention. In particular, LeBet learns an interpretable OR-of-AND monitor and accumulates evidence through a fixed betting statistic, intervening when the evidence reaches a prescribed threshold. translated_title: 先学习再下注：学习可解释规则以实现可靠的智能体干预
translated_abstract: 自主智能体现在可以在很少或没有人类监督的情况下运行数百步。在实践中，从业者使用运行时监控器（如轮次限制和关键词过滤器）来决定何时应停止、升级或协助某次运行。然而，这些启发式方法可能会停止本来会成功的运行，或让失败的运行继续下去。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了LeBet（Learn then Bet，先学习再下注），这是一个统计学习框架，其学习目标源自有效且强有力干预的充分条件。特别地，LeBet学习一个可解释的“或-与”（OR-of-AND）监控器，并通过固定的下注统计量积累证据，当证据达到预设阈值时进行干预。在有限的类内可交换性和留一稳定性条件下，我们利用相同的轨迹数据，推导出了有限样本保证，用于控制假阳性（有效性）以及以训练数据为条件的检测功效。
tldr: 提出了LeBet统计学习框架，通过学习可解释的“或-与”规则监控器并结合固定下注统计量积累证据，在达到阈值时对自主智能体运行进行干预，并提供有限样本下的假阳性控制和检测功效保证。
en_tdlr: LeBet is a statistical learning framework that learns an interpretable OR-of-AND monitor and accumulates evidence via a fixed betting statistic to reliably intervene in autonomous agent runs, with finite-sample guarantees for false-positive control and detection power.
